properties.summary: A governed disease-first research workflow that discovers evidence-linked candidate targets and controls target-specific X/Y/Z diligence.
goals: Run independently owned X/Y/Z diligence for every selected target
Preserve evidence and auditable human control
constraints: The agent cannot approve its own change
technical_choices: Independent target and axis run identifiers
risks: Missing records can be mistaken for absence
A release or repair must not bypass human review
